title: The predictive value of pressure recording analytical method for the duration of mechanical ventilation in children undergoing cardiac surgery with an XGBoost-based machine learning model.
summary: The study reports a specific pediatric postoperative ventilation-duration prediction result. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: XGBoost and related machine-learning models use pressure-recording analytical variables to predict duration of mechanical ventilation after pediatric cardiac surgery.
